build_resnet_model: build a ResNet50 model with Haiku using configurable width and number of classes for image classification
create_resnet_variant: create a ResNet101 or ResNet152 variant by specifying the variant name and depth pattern
run_resnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ResNet model returning logits and pool outputs
review_resblockv2_block: review the ResBlockV2 preactivation residual block with 1x1-3x3-1x1 bottleneck and squeeze-excite support
refactor_resblockv1_block: refactor the ResBlockV1 post-activation residual block to modify normalization or activation behavior
